verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a programmatic filing or search API with scoped credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API or credential system of any kind: there is no OpenAPI spec, the online filing host resets agent connections, and the Business Express portal disallows all crawling. Interaction is through web forms, mail, phone and credit-card authorization forms, with nothing about issuing least-privilege keys to an agent.
